order: Complete a blind validation pass against the pre-registered follow-on corpus. Save and fingerprint the independent pass before the sealed corpus file is unsealed, then compare it against the primary pass to report agreement, disagreement, and ambiguity counts against the full-gate threshold of eighteen out of twenty items. Separately grade the sealed subset drawn to validate the second class redraw against its own gate, keeping that subset apart from the full-corpus tally. Where the full pass misses items outside that subset, draw a narrowly scoped third redraw limited to those misses, sharpening one classifier's evidence-object definition and defining the diagnosis corollary's threshold for when a cause counts as stated. Add exactly one new classifier for the newly implicated class pair, but leave the three other named classifiers unchanged. Mark the corpus closed once graded, and require a fresh blinded corpus before the downstream work order proceeds.
claims: The independent pass agreed with the primary pass on 16 of 20 items with zero ambiguity flags, missing the eighteen-of-twenty full-gate threshold, so the downstream work order stays blocked. The sealed subset drawn for the second class redraw graded nine of ten, passing its own gate and validating that redraw. The three misses outside the subset drove a narrow third redraw: one classifier's evidence object was sharpened, the diagnosis corollary's threshold was defined, and exactly one new classifier was added, while the other three stayed unchanged.
